title: Oven Roasted Spanish Turkey Mince Crema Catalana
description: A rich and tender Spanish dish featuring turkey mince, simmered in a flavorful sauce and served in a traditional molcajete, paleo-friendly and perfect for special occasions. This crema catalana is a show-off dish that will impress your guests.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the turkey mince to the skillet and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the mixture to a molcajete or a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and cream.
Pour the egg mixture over the turkey mixture in the molcajete.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
